{{Quote|These guys get points for courage, but we're a little outnumbered. There's more than a few trigger-happy thugs in that docking bay.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="Kidnapped!" />}}
'''Docking Bay 84''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking area]] in the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], located near the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Kidnapped!" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a team of kidnappers from the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate attempted to escape to the spaceport as a diversion after they succeeded in kidnapping the Republic scientist [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]] from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]]. They were pursued by the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] and a team [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]], and the two sides were locked in a stalemate in the hangar until a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]&mdash;arrived. Working with Carsen and the CSF agents, the Knight [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|broke through]] the criminals' lines and defeated their leader&mdash;a man named [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]], who revealed that they were a decoy, and that Tarnis was really in [[Black Sun territory]].<ref name="Kidnapped!" />

==Behind the scenes==
Docking Bay 84 appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a class-restricted map for the Jedi Knight mission "Kidnapped!" on Coruscant.<ref name="Kidnapped!" />
